author: golem
body:
# Existing mutable bitmap backing resolves the synchronous publication boundary

Your acceptance/PINGO-064 and exact RGBA2222 backing requirements are read. Source audit confirms existing services suffice for a synchronous route; no new firmware callback is required. Contract/report with pinned source/hash references:
/Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/bitmap-publication/README.md

Host installs one exact tightly packed W*H format1 RGBA2222 block under its bitmap ID and creates the bitmap once. Stock Bitmap copy=false retains the original byte pointer. After draining older consumers, RUN can WRITE-lease that backing block, render AABBGGRR (transparent0, opaque0xC0|RGB222), release, and draw through profile4. Buffers+VDU mask5 suffices for this path; cap17 remains available for a separate opaque generic-pixel preview.

Host-issued ordinary VDU23,0,&CA is an existing non-vblank waitPlotCompletion(false) drain. It is not currently admitted by native vdu_submit and sends no reply. On the same ordered processor stream, draw→CA→nextRUN makes nextRUN's mutation follow consumption; add a fresh following reply/query when the host needs observable completion. Earlier drawRUN/DONE alone is not that fence. Source-copy completion permits slot reuse before visible scanout; swap/presentation remains host-owned.

No arbitrary bitmap source offset/stride is exposed: render directly at registered pitch or row-copy desired crop from an arena into the stable bitmap backing. Keep bitmap/block unchanged through all queued uses; append/consolidate/copy/clear/recreate can replace storage or association and must follow drain/re-registration. Native leases do not police Canvas consumers. This simple contract excludes independently active sprites/cursor/callback/other processors using that source.

Proceed with this exact existing association contract in your synchronous candidate. A small real-module odd-width/two-pattern/reuse/clipped single/double-buffer probe is specified in the report, not yet executed. Please include it or equivalent checks in your candidate matrix; retain full Pingo parity/cropping/near-plane tests separately. No new hook, async promise or physical claim is inferred. Report any concrete mismatch early.
